## 2026-11-12 00:20-00:30 UTC — pass 1 attempt 1 ABORTED: wrong fork revision was serving

- The engine reported `v0.30.1rc1.dev114+ge1423a4d7`, i.e. the ORIGINAL fork, not the rebased v0.31.0 line.
  Cause: `alignment/profiler/vllm_server.py::build_server_env` rebuilds the server's `PYTHONPATH` to the checked-out
  `alignment/profiler/vllm` submodule (gitlink e1423a4d7), which shadows the venv's editable install from the
  `vllm-v0.31.0` worktree; the launch record `fork_git.head` = e1423a4d7 confirms it. The submodule dir also held
  the 04730e8 native extensions from the fallback-env install. Nothing was measured: the server was in weight
  loading / startup (no engine-ready line, no autotune output) when the launcher got SIGINT at 00:22:51 UTC
  (`rc=1`); two leftover vLLM/nsys processes were TERM/KILLed; GPUs back to 0 MiB / 0 compute apps at 00:22:59.
  Artifacts of the aborted attempt moved to `quadrant_nsys/attempt1-wrongfork/` (launch json, server log).
- Fix: the submodule is now **detached at 0ab18711** (the rebased commit; the branch stays in the
  `vllm-v0.31.0` worktree), its stale `.so` files and `vllm.egg-info` removed, and the `fork-env-v0.31.0` venv
  reinstalled editable from the submodule path over the precompiled v0.31.0 cu130 aarch64 wheel. Verified with
  `PYTHONPATH=<submodule> python -c 'import vllm'` → `0.31.1.dev17+g0ab187113` from the submodule dir, 11 native
  extensions present, `VLLM_NVTX_SCOPES_FOR_PROFILING` present. `scripts/build_fork_env_v0310.sh` now points at
  the submodule path. The `fork-env-base` fallback venv is **no longer valid** (its editable install also
  targets the submodule dir); recreate it from a separate clone if it is ever needed.
- Config deviation fixed at the same time: the profiler defaults `--api-server-count` to 4; the recipe / vLLM
  default is 1, so `server.api_server_count: 1` is now explicit (plan: keep the recipe's and vLLM's defaults).
- From attempt 1's engine line (same checkpoint, same flags; to be re-confirmed on attempt 2): quantization
  `deepseek_v4_fp8`, dtype bf16, kv_cache_dtype fp8, max_seq_len 131072, TP4/DP1, compilation mode NONE,
  cudagraph_mode FULL_AND_PIECEWISE, cudagraph_capture_sizes 1..256 (max 256, vLLM's default for max_num_seqs 128),
  compile_ranges_endpoints [6553, 16384], prefix caching on, chunked prefill on, max_num_batched_tokens 16384.

Env (beyond the cache dirs listed in the setup section): `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3`, `CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID`,
`VLLM_NVTX_SCOPES_FOR_PROFILING=1`, `VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1`, `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=3600`, `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`.
Recipe flags are verbatim. Non-recipe flags are all launcher/profiler plumbing (`--tokens-only`, `--profiler-config.profiler=cuda`,
`--enable-logging-iteration-details`, `--enable-server-load-tracking`, `--enable-prompt-tokens-details`, `--host/--port`) or explicit
restatements of vLLM 0.31 defaults for this GPU class (`--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`, `--enable-chunked-prefill`,
`--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9`, `--data-parallel-size 1`, `--api-server-count 1`).

**Scheduler (effective).** `max_num_seqs=128` (recipe), `max_num_batched_tokens=16384` (= 0.31 default for >=160 GiB GPUs),
`enable_chunked_prefill=True`, `enable_prefix_caching=True`, `max_seq_len=131072`, `kv_cache_dtype=fp8`, KV block size forced to
**128** by the sparse backends (`Setting kv cache block size to 128 for FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41/DEEPSEEK_SPARSE_SWA/
DEEPSEEK_V41_SPARSE_INDEXER/CompressorBackend`), KV layout `BLHNC`, `speculative_config=None`, `seed=0`, `skip_tokenizer_init=True`
(tokens-only API), `tokenizer_mode=deepseek_v41`, `quantization=deepseek_v4_fp8` (UE8M0 scale fmt -> DeepGEMM E8M0 enabled),
`dtype=bf16`. Parallelism: TP4, PP1, DP1, DCP1, no EP flag (`enable_expert_parallel` absent -> TP-sharded MoE); EP group `ep:0` exists
only as the trivial all-reduce group (`PYNCCL`), TP all-reduce dispatch order `FLASHINFER, CUSTOM, SYMM_MEM, PYNCCL`.

**CUDA graphs / compilation.** `compilation_config.mode = NONE` (no torch.compile, no inductor; `splitting_ops=[]`),
`cudagraph_mode = FULL_AND_PIECEWISE`, `cudagraph_num_of_warmups=1`, `max_cudagraph_capture_size=256`, capture sizes
1,2,4,8,16,24,...,256 (step 8 from 24), `compile_ranges_endpoints=[6553,16384]`, pass_config fuse_norm_quant/fuse_act_quant/
fuse_allreduce_rms on (no effect while mode=NONE), `kernel_config`: flashinfer autotune **on**, cutedsl warmup on, jit warmup on,
`moe_backend=auto`, `sparse_indexer_topk_backend=auto`, `linear_backend=auto`.

**Backends chosen at boot (server.log).**
- attention: `FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41` (+ `DEEPSEEK_SPARSE_SWA`, `DEEPSEEK_V41_SPARSE_INDEXER`, `CompressorBackend` sub-backends);
  `Using MXFP4 indexer cache for Lightning Indexer` (indexer_kv_dtype=mxfp4 honoured). (`FLASH_ATTN for vit attention` is the unused
  vision stub, model runs `--language-model-only`.)
- MoE: `Using 'FLASHINFER_TRTLLM_MXFP4_MXFP8' Mxfp4 MoE backend`, `Using TrtLlmMxfp4ExpertsModular`; MXFP8 GEMM:
  `FlashInferCutedslMxfp8LinearKernel` and `DeepGemmMxfp8BmmLinearKernel` (vendored `vllm.third_party.deep_gemm`, PDL enabled).
- Engram: `EngramConfig(cpu_offload=True, ...)`, table offloaded to pinned host memory, 96 M rows x 256, 23.60 GiB per rank,
  token map 129280 -> 99092 ids for layers (1, 14).
- sampling: FlashInfer top-p/top-k.
- weights: 475.25 GiB checkpoint over AUTOFS, `Loading weights took 95.56 s`, `Model loading took 78.42 GiB memory and ~185 s` per rank.

**Intentional frontend deviation.** The recipe's `VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1` is NOT set: the alignment fork instruments the Python
API server (`VibeSimAlignmentRequestTiming`, request/iteration ids) and the launcher drives `/start_profile`/`/stop_profile` through it;
`--api-server-count 1` (recipe value, launcher default of 4 overridden in `profile.json`). Any frontend/HTTP overhead in the measured
request timings is therefore the Python frontend's, and the GPU-side kernel sequence is unaffected.

**JIT activity seen during boot (expected, pre-measurement):** flashinfer JIT builds `fp4_quantization_103` (00:30:11) and
`fused_moe_trtllm_sm100` (00:31:53), TileLang `mhc_pre_big_fuse_with_norm_tilelang` (00:31:30-40). FlashInfer autotune and CUDA-graph
capture follow; all land in the persistent caches under `gb300/cache/` so later passes skip them. Gate 5 will check that none of
this appears inside the nsys capture window.

**GPU occupancy at 00:31:22Z (tray16, nvidia-smi):** 4 compute apps = the 4 TP workers (pids 3646175-78), 86.6 GiB used per GPU
